question: Which of the following is NOT a complete economic evaluation?

options.opb: Analysis of direct and indirect costs.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Cost minimization analysis -> Compares costs of two or more interventions with equivalent outcomes -> Focuses solely on cost differences -> 90% CHAIN: Analysis of direct and indirect costs -> Evaluates all costs associated with an intervention -> Includes both direct medical costs and indirect costs -> 90% CHAIN: Cost-effectiveness analysis -> Measures the cost per unit of health outcome gained -> Compares different interventions in terms of cost-effectiveness -> 90% CHAIN: Cost-utility analysis -> Measures costs in terms of quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) gained -> Evaluates interventions based on their cost per QALY -> 90% CHAIN: Cost-benefit analysis -> Compares costs and benefits of an intervention in monetary terms -> Weighs the financial costs against the monetary value of outcomes -> 90%
analysis: A cost minimization analysis is not a complete economic evaluation as it focuses solely on comparing costs of different interventions that have equivalent outcomes.
